text.6:25: Of them are some who listen unto thee, but We have placed upon their hearts veils, lest they should understand, and in their ears a deafness. If they saw every token they would not believe therein; to the point that, when they come unto thee to argue with thee, the disbelievers say: This is naught else than fables of the men of old.
text.7:204: And when the Qur'an is recited, give ear to it and pay heed, that ye may obtain mercy.
text.10:42: And of them are some who listen unto thee. But canst thou make the deaf to hear even though they apprehend not?
text.17:47: We are Best Aware of what they wish to hear when they give ear to thee and when they take secret counsel, when the evil-doers say: Ye follow but a man bewitched.
text.20:13: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
text.21:2: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
text.22:73: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!
text.26:25: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
text.39:18: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding.
text.46:29: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.
text.47:16: Among them are some who give ear unto thee (Muhammad) till, when they go forth from thy presence they say unto those who have been given knowledge: What was that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah hath sealed, and they follow their own lusts.
text.50:41: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
text.52:38: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
text.72:1: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
text.72:9: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
